description: This file defines a PHP class for a SuiteCRM dashlet related to AOS_PDF_Templates. It extends the DashletGeneric class and initializes dashlet properties such as title, search fields, columns, and seed bean, primarily for displaying AOS_PDF_Templates records in the SuiteCRM interface.

classes.name: AOS_PDF_TemplatesDashlet
classes.description: A class extending DashletGeneric to provide dashlet functionality for AOS_PDF_Templates in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the dashlet with data, setting the title, search fields, columns, and seed bean for AOS_PDF_Templates.
